basis.note: Shared radial boundaries are cross-source candidates. Applying all 72 sectors to every band is a structural hypothesis to test, not an observation.

h441Assessment.reason: The shared outer-boundary model alone yields neither 441 nor evidence sufficient to refute it. Source-specific radial bands and central-rose topology remain unresolved.

h22Assessment.reason: Central region is explicitly excluded from forced 72-sector topology and requires independent petal/path census.

promotionRequirements: Demonstrate that each of the 72 radial boundaries traverses each proposed outer band as a structural divider.
Measure source-specific radial boundaries rather than discarding them merely because they are not shared.
Separate central-rose topology from outer polar topology.
Generate per-cell evidence before assigning AK identities.
